model: Test model with a floor plan that shows at least five doors and some windows, with no door tags and no window tags in that plan, at least one level with no floor plan, and at least one 3D view. Replace every angle-bracket placeholder with a real name from this model before running.
note: Ten tagging prompts, each run once, to measure how the Copilot tags today, before the tag job is hardened. Each step is one drafter message unless it says otherwise. Reopen the model without saving, make the view named in the step the active view, and start a new Copilot chat before every step. D = number of doors visible in <Plan A>, W = number of windows visible in <Plan A>, both counted once by the tester in Revit. The Copilot must not choose for the drafter, must ask before it creates something that was not asked for, must never tag another view than the one asked for, and must not ask what has a default (leaders are off by default; with one tag type loaded for the category there is nothing to ask). 'expect' is what to check in Revit afterwards.

steps.area: Tags: all doors in the active plan (English)
steps.text: Tag all doors in this view.
steps.expect: Active view: <Plan A>. No question, unless the model has more than one door tag type (then one question: which tag type, naming the types). D new door tags in <Plan A>, one per door, none doubled. No tag in any other view. The reply states the number tagged. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Tags: all doors in the active plan (Malay)
steps.text: tag semua pintu dalam view ni
steps.expect: Active view: <Plan A>. Same result as t01: D new door tags, one per door, none in another view. Any question is in English. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: Tag all windows in this view.
steps.expect: Active view: <Plan A>. W new window tags in <Plan A>, one per window. No door is tagged. No question, unless there is more than one window tag type. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Tags: the active view cannot hold tags (English)
steps.expect: Active view: a 3D view (<3D View>). The Copilot says this view cannot be tagged and asks which plan, section or elevation to use (or asks the drafter to open one). No tag is placed anywhere before the answer, and it does not pick a plan itself. Answer: <Plan A>. Then D new door tags in <Plan A>. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Tags: the plan asked for does not exist (Malay)
steps.text: tag semua pintu dalam pelan <Level Without Floor Plan>
steps.expect: Active view: <Plan A>. One question back: there is no plan for <Level Without Floor Plan>; create one or skip? No view and no tag is created before the answer, and no door in <Plan A> is tagged instead. Answer: skip. Nothing in the model changed.

steps.area: Tags: a named plan that is not the active view (English)
steps.text: Tag all doors in the <Plan B> floor plan.
steps.expect: Active view: <Plan A>. <Plan B> is another floor plan that shows doors and has no door tags. The doors visible in <Plan B> get one tag each in <Plan B>. No tag is placed in <Plan A>. No question, unless there is more than one door tag type. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Tags: everything is already tagged (English, second message in the same chat)
steps.text: Tag all doors in this view.
steps.expect: Setup: active view <Plan A>; send this prompt once and let it finish (as t01), then send the same prompt again in the same chat. This step is about the SECOND message. No new tag is placed, no tag is doubled, and the reply says the doors are already tagged, with the number. No question. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Tags: the drafter names the tag type (English)
steps.text: Tag all doors in this view with the <Door Tag Type B> tag.
steps.expect: Active view: <Plan A>. Only if the model has a second door tag type; otherwise mark this step not applicable. D new door tags, all of type <Door Tag Type B>. No question. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Tags: the tag type named does not exist (English)
steps.text: Tag all doors in this view with the ZZ9-NOTAG tag.
steps.expect: Active view: <Plan A>. The model has no door tag type named ZZ9-NOTAG. The Copilot says so and names the real door tag types, as a question. No tag is placed before the answer and no tag type is created or loaded. Answer: skip. Nothing in the model changed.

Active view: <Plan A>. One question back: which category (doors, windows, ...). It must not pick a category itself and must not tag every category without asking. Answer: doors. Then D new door tags in <Plan A> and no other tags. Nothing else changed.
